description: Hello #TeamCastro! It is hard to believe that we are only 71 days away from Election Day. Now, more than ever, we need your help. This campaign has always been about building a movement rooted in service, community and a core belief that leadership should put people first. This Wednesday at 7 pm at Kirkwood Presbyterian Church, #TeamCastro is hosting our Volunteer Kickoff Party. Come meet fellow supporters, hear from special guests and learn how you can get involved. Every door knocked, call made, conversation started, and hour volunteered brings us one step closer to Election Day. We can’t do this without you, and we hope to see you there! Let's celebrate Democracy together! Darcy Castro Candidate for Georgia Senate District 37
title: News from Darcy Castro
